newsitem.title: FRANCE: More countries trying to make EMU - de Silguy.
newsitem.headline: More countries trying to make EMU - de Silguy.

text.p: More and more countries are trying to meet Maastricht Treaty criteria for entry into European economic and monetary union, European Commissioner for Economic and Financial Affairs Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Thursday.
In an interview on French television, he declined however to say which countries he expected to join monetary union in 1999.
"There are more and more countries making more and more and more effort to get in," he said.
"There will be a significant number which will be in the euro," he said. "I am not in a position to say today what the list (of countries) will be. There is a treaty and the treaty will be applied."
De Silguy said late last month that there may be an "increasing number" of countries ready for monetary union given big efforts made across Europe to reduce budget deficits.
